title:
Support for executing blocks of code in a single db/SQL transaction
IMPORTANT: NOTE THE FOLLOWING RESTRICTIONS

1. Nested transactions are not supported.
2. Only supports "sql" datastore.  Any other datastores accessed (e.g. external or KV) will throw an exception.
3. No internal retry of steps since any SQL error rolls back the transaction.  Retry should be implemented outside
   of the transaction.
4. All `upsert` operations run implicitly with {@link UpsertSpec.forceAsyncCalcFieldRefresh} set
5. All invalidations are committed after the main transaction is committed to avoid them firing prematurely.  As
   such, there is no ability (or reason) to "wait" for queues to finish computing.
6. Not appropriate for jobs/async (e.g. batch, mapReduce, or workflow, AsyncAction, etc.).
7. All types participating in the transaction must be in the default Db.Domain (e.g. they can't specify
   {@link Ann.Db#domain}).  An exception will be thrown if any such types are accessed.
8. Types that specify the "system" domain may be accessed in the transaction but will not participate in the
   transaction.
9. Accessing a {@link Cached} type that doesn't specify the "system" domain" within a transiction is not supported
   will throw an exception as cache invalidation will not work properly within the transaction semantics.
name: Db.Transaction
